raw_trade_id_discontinuity_interpretatio.observation: Every one of the 8 days shows several thousand small discontinuities where a row's first_trade_id is not exactly (previous row's last_trade_id + 1).
raw_trade_id_discontinuity_interpretatio.magnitude_check: Sampled the full distribution for 2026-09-04: 13208 gaps of size 1, 308 of size 2, 7 of size 3, maximum gap size 3. No large jumps were found on any sampled day.
raw_trade_id_discontinuity_interpretatio.assessment: This is consistent with the well-known characteristic that Binance's underlying trade-id counter is not exclusive to a single symbol/aggTrades stream, so small (1-3) gaps in one symbol's own id sequence are expected and are not, by themselves, evidence of missing BTCUSDT market data. This assessment is this session's own reasoning from the observed gap-size distribution, not a claim verified against official Binance documentation of the id-allocation scheme.
raw_trade_id_discontinuity_interpretatio.why_this_does_not_block_discovery_readin: The Contract's price reconstruction only requires a trade at/after window start and a trade at/before window end (bisection on transact_time), and the max observed gap between consecutive aggTrade rows on any day is under 10 seconds -- far smaller than the Contract's 60-second effort window or 300/900/1800-second horizons. A few-ID gaps in the global counter would only matter if they coincided with an actual multi-minute silence in trading, which the max_consecutive_row_gap_seconds figures above rule out for all 8 days.
